    pfs=""
>
[Traveler's Fulu](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2693)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Fulu" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=378" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Talisman" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=155" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 83

**Price** 7 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to armor

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Free Action" /><row>envision</row></row>

 

**Trigger** You critically fail an attempt to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=64)

**Requirement** You're trained in [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16)
</row>

</column>

---

This fulu shows a series of constellations and arrows depicting astronomical movements through the night sky. When you activate a _traveler's fulu_, the magic infuses your mind with sensations of deja vu, as if you'd been in this region before. You gain a success on the triggering check.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
